title: Hellblade: Senua's Sacrifice
provenance: Reported by brunobrancoo (highball-db#788, 2026-10-29), Apple M5, macOS 26.4.1, Highball 0.10.22, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r28, DXMT, msync, rated 3 of 5 after 94 minutes: it needs -dx11 as a launch option, and with it everything works. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: Reported working fully on an M5 with DXMT over 94 minutes once the game is started with -dx11, which Play passes from the next Highball version (until then put -dx11 in the game's Launch arguments under Game settings). Without it the game takes its DirectX 12 path, which DXMT does not have.

knownIssues.symptom: Does not start in DXMT mode without -dx11
knownIssues.cause: the game picks DirectX 12, which DXMT does not provide
knownIssues.fix: start it with -dx11. Play passes it from this page from the next Highball version. Until then put it in Launch arguments under the game's Game settings
